headline: Amazon Bedrock enhances with granular cost attribution and model distillation for cost-efficient AI.

items.title: Introducing granular cost attribution for Amazon Bedrock
items.summary: Amazon has introduced granular cost attribution for its Bedrock service, enabling detailed tracking of expenses associated with running AI models. This addition allows developers to better understand and manage costs through various scenarios, offering transparency in resource usage. The post explains the implementation of cost tracking, which is crucial for optimizing AI workflows on the platform.
items.why_it_matters: Tech leads can optimize budget allocation by understanding cost structures for AI model deployment on Amazon Bedrock.

items.title: Optimize video semantic search intent with Amazon Nova Model Distillation on Amazon Bedrock
items.summary: Amazon has showcased a new Model Distillation technique on Bedrock that transfers knowledge from a large teacher model to a smaller student model, drastically reducing inference costs by over 95%. This technique allows for efficient semantic search by leveraging a smaller, cost-effective model without sacrificing accuracy.
items.why_it_matters: This innovation is crucial for tech leads aiming to reduce operational costs while maintaining high performance in AI applications.

items.title: Codex for (almost) everything
items.summary: OpenAI has updated its Codex app for macOS and Windows, adding features like computer use, in-app browsing, image generation, memory, and plugins. These enhancements are designed to streamline developer workflows and provide more integrated AI capabilities across various tasks.

items.title: Full-Stack Optimizations for Agentic Inference with NVIDIA Dynamo
items.summary: NVIDIA has detailed full-stack optimizations for agentic inference using its Dynamo platform, enhancing performance for AI applications. This includes improvements in efficiency and speed, which are critical for deploying complex AI models in production environments.

items.title: Building a Fast Multilingual OCR Model with Synthetic Data
items.summary: Hugging Face, in collaboration with NVIDIA, has released a post on developing a fast multilingual OCR model using synthetic data. This approach aims to enhance OCR capabilities across multiple languages, leveraging synthetic datasets to train robust models efficiently.

items.title: Show HN: I made a calculator that works over disjoint sets of intervals
items.summary: A developer has showcased an interval calculator designed to operate over disjoint sets, leveraging interval arithmetic. This tool is aimed at providing more precise calculations in areas where traditional arithmetic falls short.

all_items.title: Optimize video semantic search intent with Amazon Nova Model Distillation on Amazon Bedrock
all_items.summary: In this post, we show you how to use Model Distillation, a model customization technique on Amazon Bedrock, to transfer routing intelligence from a large teacher model (Amazon Nova Premier) into a much smaller student model (Amazon Nova Micro). This approach cuts inference cost by over 95% and reduces latency by 50% while maintaining the nuanced routing quality that the task demands.

all_items.title: Power video semantic search with Amazon Nova Multimodal Embeddings
all_items.summary: In this post, we show you how to build a video semantic search solution on Amazon Bedrock using Nova Multimodal Embeddings that intelligently understands user intent and retrieves accurate video results across all signal types simultaneously. We also share a reference implementation you can deploy and explore with your own content.
